newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC, CityDev, Hyundai make highest land bids.
newsitem.headline: FCC, CityDev, Hyundai make highest land bids.

text.p: The Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) of Singapore said on Wednesday First Capital Corp Ltd has submitted the highest bid of Singapore $87.3 million for a land parcel for commercial development.

It also said City Developments Ltd and Hyundai Engineering & Construction Co Ltd had made the highest offer of S$103.8 million for another parcel of land for commercial and residential or hotel development.
The FCC bid was for a 803.20 square metre site in Singapore's business district at Robinson Road.
City Developments and Hyundai bid for a 6,283 square metre plot at Middle Road/Bencoolen Street, close to the business district.
URA added in a statement Cosmopolitan Development Pte Ltd had made the highest bid of S$53.38 million for a 1,581.64 square metre plot of land at Anson Road/Bernam Road.
All three sites were launched on August 28 and were sold on 99-year leases.
